metadata.dataset: BIA AIAN Land Area Representation — every reservation within 2 miles of the North Country Trail centerline (full unclipped geometry)
metadata.area_note: area_acres is geometry-measured (geodesic, WGS84). BIA's GISACRES attribute contradicts its own geometry by ~2.17x on the two Minnesota reservations checked in ITM and is NOT used; it is carried as gisacres_attribute for the record.
